paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 10, saying: “It is an encoded expression: dust in his mother’s eyes.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The exact Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:10 text, index 3, explicitly has Rabbi Luda explaining תוגת אמו with לישן גימטריון הוא and dust-in-his-mother’s-eyes. This supports the full title and encoded-expression interpretation; הוא functions as copula, not an asserted numerical equality Lishan=Hu.

פ״ג ה״י explicitly giveschapter 3 halakhah 10. The earlier note’s interpretation attributed to Penei Moshe—Greek wording hinting through gematria—remains an attributed historical interpretation; no fresh Penei Moshe inspection is claimed in this lane. The encoded expression’s detailed derivation remains unexplained by the short notice.
